horoscopes.horoscope: The day may start with a dilemma, but that’s exactly how your skills will come into play. As evening approaches, you will be applauded for your outstanding performance. If Ganesha is particularly generous today, you may sign new agreements. Your love life seems free of trouble, with no storm clouds hovering on the horizon. However, Ganesha feels that normal lifestyle may bore you. Adventurous time is not foreseen, though you may do a salsa together or dine out in a peaceful retro-bar. You will be energetic today. You will also maintain good rapport with friends. You may need to use your energy in taking initiatives about pending communications. Besides, your mind will be very sharp today. You won’t feel tired easily either. Ganesha feels that today you are not likely to have any major financial windfall but your mind will be active about earning more money so you may have big plans on your mind. Streamline your thoughts if you want to avoid confusion. Misunderstandings might happen with your colleagues. Today, astral forces will conspire to help you logically carry out research activities. Properly planned approach will help you fetch desired results.

Priorities and money matters will line up impatiently to knock on your door (and desk). Your financial constraints will get an outburst today. People may be taken by surprise with the way you get poignant. You will also enjoy the higher accountability reposed on you, predicts Ganesha. Though you are helpful your self-centred approach may not be appreciated by your loved one. You have to be broad minded when it comes to the relationship, feels Ganesha. You need to understand the needs of your spouse. Your friendly attitude will keep relationship smooth. Your efficiency will soar on this awesome day. Things that others avoid doing, and take more time to complete – you shall do willingly and effortlessly. Meetings for official or personal reasons are indicated. But, don’t waste your energy after fruitless discussions. You will try to be too secure. This may cause you to miss several financial opportunities. At the same time, Ganesha fears that you will probably not be able to justify every source of earning. A day to start or buy new things, predicts Ganesha. Time management will be important. Try to be flexible, feels Ganesha. Gifting yourself a new desktop or a flash drive will help boost your productivity. As a result, you’ll finish assignments on time.

Today, you will get an opportunity to rejuvenate yourself with seamless energy. How? Ganesha’s guess is that you will find — or at least you will believe that you have found — your purpose in life. It will keep you excited throughout the day, and maybe even for days to come. You may spend lavishly to improve your personal appearance. Such expenditures are only an investment, feels Ganesha. You are the centre of attention and you along with your sweetheart are the perfect couple. You are even going to be a hit with your loved one, who’s going to stick to you like glue-courtesy your magnetic appeal. Ganesha wonders at the sparks that’ll fly. You will be increasing your efficiency today. The day will be pretty productive for you today and you will approach every matter in a more planned and organised way. You will organize your finances and maintain family environment. No health problems are foreseen today. You are likely to remain unsure about your financial matters. You wouldn’t be able to decide on what to do in order to earn more. You will also be confused about the ways of saving money. You may goof up while making decisions. You no need to worry, says Ganesha. Though your schedule is demanding, today you’ll have an upper hand in analyzing and collecting data. You will eventually speed up the things and your productivity will fetch good results.

Ganesha believes that today you may have to take certain financial decisions at home as well as at work. If you are in-charge of a certain project, you will trust the judgement of those working on it, mostly because they have been hand-picked by you. In love, be gentle and compromising. Your sweetheart can be the best joy of your life. Learn a lot of new things from your loved one. You smooth interaction with your sweetheart will make you happier. You will be able to lead a peaceful life. You will be in a very good mood today. You will be full of energy as well; however, you pursuing too many tasks which could divide you energy. Your surrounding will be very demanding. You should be alert to everything that comes to you. Ganesha foresees that you may be required to spend a lot. There are more chances of spending money and less chances of earning a good sum. You will feel good about your spending. If you love numbers, you’ll rank number one today! That’s because your sharp memory will enable you to be an absolute smoothie with digits and integers. You will be able to crack many complex issues in the meeting room. Decision making will come smoothly to you.

You are blessed with a visionary’s creative streak. Perhaps, that’s why, you see things differently from others. Today, thanks to the stars, your creative side will surge forth with renewed vigour. You will generate ideas effortlessly and continuously as you reach your creative peak. Just remember that having an imaginative mind means learning lessons from the past and visualising a better future. So, ideate responsibly, advises Ganesha. Champagne, roses, and dark chocolates would make the perfect mood of romance. You will be blissful to bring a smile on your lover’s face. Enjoy the best of the evening out of the home. Singing, dancing or refreshing in the swimming pool together might help you get intimate with your partner. You will have more memorizing and remembering power today. Besides, you will be more submissive today. So, you may not fight over things. At the same time, you might lose hope on certain things today which could lead to frustration and depression. You will have a good scope of earning money. Those who owe you money will either pay you or at least will give a committment that they will pay you soon. You will be happy. Ganesha is in the mood to make your day! You would be fortunate to people who matter the most. Get ready for some praise from the boss and some hero-worship from colleagues. Avoid getting too inspired to launch something new today. Wait for another day for that.

There will be dirt on your shoulder today, so dust it off, says Ganesha, because every time you fall you will get up stronger than before. Your logic and analytical skills will help you find the necessary precision to accomplish tasks at work. You may spend the evening with a close friend or your beloved, engrossed in a stimulating conversation. You might seem to be very choosy when it comes to your love life. Ganesha feels that you may enthrall your partner at the rendezvous. Avoid being nervous. Just prove your intelligence and hold your partner’s attention as much as you can. You are in a very good mood today. This will have a positive impact on your health. You will be making new friends. You are likely to receive appreciations that will boost your morale. As a result, you will give better work output. Lucrative job offer may enthuse you, feels Ganesha. This is the ideal time to switch over your job to a better paid one. This is a favourable day, even if you wish to change your vocation. Voila! Today’s a hitting-a-jackpot day as far as your career is concerned. You’re going to don the thinking cap and make some path-breaking decisions that will bring positive results for your finance or business. Your analytical spirits will win some important projects.

There are many kinds of worries that you must equip yourself to deal with. To do this, you may have to learn and follow the basic steps of problem-analysing techniques. The steps involve obtaining facts, analysing them and then arriving at a decision based upon your observations. Most important, though, is that you must act upon the decision thus derived, says Ganesha. You would be in the party mood today. Don’t let emotions get the better of you in matters of the heart, warns Ganesha. A travel plan is on the cards. Nature is calling you today. You might also plan to visit some exotic foreign locations with your loved one, feels Ganesha. Health wise, the day appears good for you. Even if you don’t take extra boosters, it would be fine and alright. Also, you will be delivering your best at workplace. Besides, your mind will be very active and logical today. Ganesha feels that today you will be depending more on your luck and on others for your financial progress. Your own efforts and hard work will have lesser contribution to your financial opportunities or gains. Ganesha has some surprise in store for you Librans! You may write a new set of instructions or devise a new code of programming language. Your intellectual power might be tested. Chances are that you may dazzle everyone with a new software, says Ganesha.

Ganesha feels a taxing and demanding day may be at hand today. Things might baffle you so much that you might lose your ability to think clearly. The battle is not lost because your power of resilience will be the silver lining. Address one problem at a time and take the slow and steady path, advises Ganesha. Re-discover your spirit in the arms of your sweetheart. Let all the struggles and pains wash away in the shower of the sweet words of your lover. Do not forget to hug or kiss your loved one even in the most difficult situation, inspires Ganesha. It’s a good day for you from all the angles. You are most likely to stick to routine practices today. You may not be in a mood to do the extra effort for anything or anyone. Health wise because it is a good day. You may feel that you are earning lesser than your potential. You could have done better. However, later you may see light at the end of the tunnel which is going to turn you optimistic. You are likely to have a tough day today. Beware of negative vibes you may get from jealous colleagues. Plus technical glitches may hamper smooth flow of work. All this may lead to a foul mood. Careful planning might solve your problem or smoothen your hard work, feels Ganesha.

You will discover a flair for flirting as you puppet words to your romantic will with ease and grace. Most of today will be spent in the company of a loved one, perhaps a picnic for two, or a day-long romantic date. Stay prepared for the worst as this may not necessarily blossom into a long-lasting relationship, warns Ganesha. You’ll end the day by flooring your loved one with your ‘I’ll-do-anything-for-you, sweetheart’ attitude. Be ready for oodles of kisses and bear hugs, says a smiling Ganesha. Surprise your partner with some amazing gifts. Romantic cuddle would make both of you feel softer than ever today, says Ganesha. While you are likely to be negative today, other people’s support to cheer you up can keep you in a good mood. Other people’s influence on you will be creating extreme impact on you so if you are dealing with negative people, avoid them. You will be in a mood to spend money for others. This is different from your usual behaviour. You will now feel that you should spend money for your near and dear ones, says Ganesha. Ganesha feels that you need the much-needed glass of Bournvita or a Gatorade before leaving for work since you’ll need an extra shot of energy to combat a busy day ahead. Stay away from designing software or writing program codes, warns Ganesha.

Like you weren’t already overworked, new responsibilities will keep you occupied throughout the day, says Ganesha. The excitement with which you work every day will weaken, and eventually die down by the end of the day. This is mainly because you will burn your energy and resources in helping others. But there is a good side to this too. Your social standing will improve dramatically because of your kind nature. Being circumspect will also help you in your love life. Don’t let the cacophony of clashes disturb your harmonious relationship. You should support all the good points of your loved one, feels Ganesha. You should express your feelings if you do not agree with your sweetheart. All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy. You are industrious, but it is not advisable to work all time. Rest and recreation is also necessary to avoid boredom and fatigue. Devote time for leisure activities to stay healthy. This is favourable day to apply for bank loans or personal loans but before you apply, please ensure that you are aware of your exact needs. You need to rework your day to day needs. There’ll be a race in the office today to be in the boss’ good books. Ganesha says that you should gear up for cut-throat competition at the workplace. Though things may seem normal, Ganesha advises you to be wary of what’s happening around you.

Academically, you have performed exceptionally well, and Ganesha congratulates you for that. You will inspire and motivate a number of people, and may create a fan following, too. This, however, doesn’t mean that you throw your weight around. Keep a humane and humble approach towards others. However, this seemingly tough day will certainly end on a positive note when you meet your partner and plan a quiet evening together. You might ask your partner for a soothing message therapy that might develop later into lust, feels Ganesha. Thanks to your good health, you will easily do various tasks in your workplace today. However, don’t get anxious by the work pressure. Remain composed to accomplish myriad tasks. After working hard, have a sumptuous meal and sleep well, too. You are likely to get good price for whatever you sell and you will also get good deal for whatever you are willing to buy. The day is good for analyzing value of your material possessions. A tight rein on your mood swings will help you live this day more joyously. You may have to juggle between many challenging assignments and come up with an important solution. A cool-headed approach to work is the only way to handle multiple tasks tactfully.

Your energy and enthusiasm will know no bounds today, as everything seems to fall into place, seemingly on its own. You will blaze a new trail at the work-place. Certain tough calls may leave you off-balance momentarily, but you will come out of it with flying colours. For those who are in artistic professions, fame could come knocking on your door, says Ganesha. As the evening approaches, you’d be in a tearing hurry to go back home and spend quality time with your family. You might please your loved one with some humorous acts or jokes, feels Ganesha. Preparing delicious foods with your spouse would be a nice idea. This day looks to be unusual. Expect a tug of war between your head and heart. You shall try to control your mind, but your heart will prove to be stronger. Your tired mind needs some rest – take a break. Today, you may spend money on ‘home’ or ‘family members’. You may also spend on friends or those who are very close to your heart. The day does not indicate very good earning potential. Ganesha advises you to draw a line between personal and professional life. You’ll be neck-deep in work, and won’t get any breaks today. In meetings, since you won’t have any views of your own, you may have to agree to others’ agendas.
